results.name: Pinned raw source and every distributed compressed archive match their published hashes
All source coordinates, rings, components, properties and civil dates survive the conversion
Date support rejects unsupported years; day intervals include their documented endpoints
Every supported annual frame agrees with an independent raw-source UTC date oracle, offline
Display aliases follow the selected snapshot and preserve native names and geometry
Rendering features never mutates source geometry or substitutes archive identities
Supported explicit country mode does not depend on a working overview archive
Unsupported dates and failed country requests fall back to the exact requested year
A slower prior source choice cannot overwrite a later completed mode
A source response for a previous displayed year cannot overwrite a newly committed frame
Two maps sharing a source promise keep separate mode and displayed archive state
Destroying a map invalidates pending commits
If both archives fail, the existing frame stays intact and its source is not mislabeled
Selection and overview strokes hide together when regional source becomes visible
